description: Site-wide custom code: `head` before </head>, `body` before </body>, every page. Draft until publish_site (a live-mode site's dashboard publishes only the code); never runs in the editor. ≤20,000 chars per box; `warnings` flags likely mistakes (unclosed <script>, <html>/<head>/<body>, canonical or robots tag, GA4 already connected) without rejecting. Send only the boxes you change; "" clears one. `runOn` ('live' default, or 'live-and-preview') applies at once; draft-only agents can't set it. For GTM, Clarity, ad pixels, chat widgets, verification tags; plain GA4/Plausible/Fathom/Umami: set_analytics_provider.

body.description: Code for before </body> on every page. "" clears it.

head.description: Code for before </head> on every page. "" clears it.

runOn.description: Where it runs: 'live' (live site only) or 'live-and-preview'. Applies at once.

name: set_custom_code
